messages:
morgan_h: Hey team — auditor asked for a traceability sample that ties an RBAC change to deploy artifacts, relevant audit logs, and the KMS key identifier used for secrets in that flow. They want a 7-day slice around the change. Can we produce a scrubbed package?

samir: I can pull CloudTrail + our app-audit logs. Which change exactly? need PR/commit id and rough deploy time.

morgan_h: PR #4523 — update that allowed svc-search to read index metadata. Deployed 2026-02-28 14:12 UTC from the deploy pipeline.

lisa: I'll query the log window. Auditor said to redact personal identifiers. Also they asked for key id + rotation policy — is sharing key ARNs ok?

auditor_kate: For SOC 2 we need the key identifier and rotation proof, not any key material. Key ARNs/IDs are fine; redact user principals. Also include the KMS config snapshot and rotation schedule.

samir: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail events (2/28-3/6) filtered for IAM/deploy events 2) export app-audit entries referencing svc-search/service_account 3) extract KMS key metadata and rotation logs 4) include RBAC policy git diff + commit id 5) deploy manifests + signed pipeline artifacts. We'll substitute emails with <redacted@example.com>.

infra-bot: export job started: cloudtrail-export ct-9921. ETA ~12m.

lisa: Also include the vuln scan that ran after the change — there was a low sev finding, ticket #3421. I'll attach the scan summary and remediation note.

morgan_h: Auditor wants the incident response timeline for that vuln triage too — dates and owners.

security_sam: I'll prepare an IR timeline (csv) with timestamps, actions, and verification steps. Note: KMS rotation occurred 2025-11-15; I'll include the rotation log entries.

auditor_kate: Good. Please provide the package via secure share (SFTP) and notify me. Also include a signed attestation from the engineering lead confirming redactions.

samir: Once exports finish I'll stage everything under /secure-audit/redwood/2026-03-rbac-sample and create sftp creds.

lisa: CloudTrail export finished. Snippet:
```
{ "eventTime": "2026-02-28T14:12:34Z", "eventName": "AttachRolePolicy", "userIdentity": "<redacted>", "requestParameters": {"roleName":"svc-search"} }
```

morgan_h: Thanks. auditor_kate I'll ping when the SFTP package is ready.

auditor_kate: Received SFTP link, starting download. If you can include a control-mapping doc that ties each file to SOC2 control IDs / ISO clauses it speeds review.

samir: Will add control_map.csv mapping files to control IDs and brief notes.

infra-bot: ct-9921 finished, cloudtrail-export.tar.gz uploaded to /secure-audit/redwood/2026-03-rbac-sample md5: abc123def

lisa: Added KMS metadata (key_policy.json), rotation-log.csv, RBAC git diff and PR link: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4523

security_sam: IR timeline added and signed by @morgan_h.

morgan_h: Uploaded signed attestation and redaction checklist.

auditor_kate: Quick q — notes mention a "graceful fallback" path activated by the change. Can you show authorization for that fallback and any test logs proving it worked?

samir: Authorization is in PR review comments on PR 4523. Test logs are in CI artifacts: /ci/artifacts/4523/fallback-test.log. I'll include a sanitized copy.

auditor_kate: Perfect — that should be everything I need for this slice. I'll close the review once I finish validation. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
